description: Source code for Kubernetes endpoint controller managing service endpoints, including creation, update, deletion, and endpoint truncation logic.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages Kubernetes service endpoints, including creation, update, and deletion, with support for endpoint truncation and cache synchronization.

methods.name: NewEndpointController
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new endpoint controller with informers and event handlers.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller's worker routines and manages lifecycle until context cancellation.

methods.name: syncService
methods.description: Synchronizes endpoints for a specific service, creating or updating as needed based on current pod states.

methods.name: syncPod
methods.description: Handles pod updates, enqueuing related services for endpoint updates.

methods.name: checkLeftoverEndpoints
methods.description: Detects orphaned endpoints with no associated service and enqueues them for cleanup.

methods.name: addEndpointSubset
methods.description: Adds endpoint addresses and ports to subsets, considering pod readiness and configuration.

methods.name: endpointPortFromServicePort
methods.description: Converts a service port to an endpoint port representation.

methods.name: capacityAnnotationSetCorrectly
methods.description: Checks if endpoint capacity annotations are correctly set based on current endpoints count.

methods.name: truncateEndpoints
methods.description: Distributes endpoints across subsets to enforce maximum capacity, prioritizing ready endpoints.

methods.name: addressSubset
methods.description: Returns a subset of addresses up to a maximum number.

methods.name: endpointSubsetsEqualIgnoreResourceVersion
methods.description: Compares endpoint subsets ignoring resource version differences.

methods.name: labelsCorrectForEndpoints
methods.description: Validates that endpoint labels are correctly derived from service labels, ignoring specific labels.
